settings.title: Clothes that earn their place
settings.text:
Clove & Cloth makes getting dressed easier. We bring together coats, knitwear, shirts, trousers and shoes for men and women, in a palette of warm neutrals that all work with each other, so the pieces you buy this year still belong in your wardrobe next year.

Clove & Cloth started with a simple frustration: too many clothes, too few that last. We wanted a shop where every piece earns its place, chosen for how it fits, how the fabric feels and how it looks after the twentieth wear, not the first.

The name says what we care about: the warmth and depth of clove, the brown, camel and olive tones you will find across the collection, and good cloth, cut well.

settings.title: Fit
settings.text: Does it fit the way a real body moves?

settings.title: Fabric
settings.text: Is the fabric worth what it costs?

settings.title: Next season
settings.text: Will you still reach for it next season? If not, it does not make the cut.

settings.title: Three questions before a piece goes on the site
settings.text: We write descriptions the way we would want to read them: what it is made of, how it fits and what to pair it with. If a style runs small or large, we say so.
Men and women who know what they like and do not want to start from scratch every season. If you would rather own one good coat than three you will replace, you are in the right place.

Shipping is free on every order within the United States, with no minimum spend. Orders leave us in 1 to 2 business days and arrive within 5 to 10 business days in total. Changed your mind? You have 30 days from delivery to return it. Read our Shipping policy and Return & refund policy.

We are a small team and we read every message ourselves. Write to info@cloveandcloth.com or use our contact page. We reply within 24 hours, Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (CT).

Follow us on Instagram for new arrivals and styling ideas.
